verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a compliance SaaS platform, but the evidence pack documents no bulk export, open-format download, or offboarding capability. The MCP server's read tools for listing audits and evidence requests are a developer building block, not a full data export. Docs-28 frames MCP as a way to avoid exporting data, not as an export feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
